items.name: Minnesota Newcomer Saturday 2024
items.information:
This is a very beginner-friendly competition!  All are welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaFJjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--51111b9a3e31767ba773023b6b77e41414361d4a/image.png)

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:
* 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greather than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. 
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. 

**This competition is a series competition with [Minnesota Newcomer Sunday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSunday2024).  You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.**

[Please click here for more information about series competitions. ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSaturday2024#34013-series-competitions-faq)

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaE5jIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2bd2c962584c71cb83666f3f9263bbf13f251bb9/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
